name: io.github.awesomemotive/pushengage-mcp
title: PushEngage
description: Send push notifications, build audiences, and view campaign analytics from PushEngage.

environmentVariables.name: PE_MCP_CONFIG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the token/config file. Defaults to ~/.pushengage/mcp.json. Set it to run multiple PushEngage accounts side by side.

environmentVariables.name: PE_MCP_CLIENT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Label shown on the PushEngage authorize screen as the requesting app, e.g. "Claude Desktop".
